label: Discord: Send Message
description: Post a message to the connected channel webhook: plain text, an override display name, and rich embeds.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The channel webhook (wire a DiscordWebhookAccess node).

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: Override the webhook's display name for this message.

inputs.name: embeds
inputs.description: Discord embed objects (title, description, color, fields, ...).

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: The created message as Discord answered it.
